# fpcloud_app_config (Resource)

Manages one environment variable of a Fogpipe application: a literal `value`, or a reference to a `secret` (`org/<name>` for an organization secret) delivered as the variable or, with `path`, as a file the variable names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A plain environment variable.
resource "fpcloud_app_config" "api_url" {
  app_id = fpcloud_app.web.id
  key    = "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL"
  value  = "https://api.example.com"
}

# A credential: the variable references a project secret and holds its value.
resource "fpcloud_app_config" "stripe_key" {
  app_id = fpcloud_app.web.id
  key    = "STRIPE_KEY"
  secret = fpcloud_secret.stripe.name
}

# The same secret delivered as a file; the variable holds the path.
resource "fpcloud_app_config" "stripe_key_file" {
  app_id = fpcloud_app.web.id
  key    = "STRIPE_KEY_FILE"
  secret = fpcloud_secret.stripe.name
  path   = "/secrets/stripe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The application ID this config belongs to.
- `key` (String) The configuration key (environment variable name).

### Optional

- `path` (String) With `secret`: deliver the value as a file at this absolute path, and make the variable hold the path.
- `secret` (String) The secret the variable references, by name in the project or as `org/<name>`: its value is the variable's, or the file's at `path`. Referencing a secret hands the app's identity the resource behind it.
- `value` (String) The literal value. Env is plain: it reads back in full. A credential belongs in fpcloud_secret, referenced with `secret` (as `org/<name>` for an organization secret). Exactly one of `value` and `secret` is set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the config entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "app_id/key".
terraform import fpcloud_app_config.api_url 9f3e6b1d-7a2c-4d8f-b5e9-1c0a8d6f4b2e/NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
```
